init.title: Weheat Portal Authentication (Write Access)
init.description: The standard Home Assistant OAuth client (`HomeAssistantAPI`) only provides read access to `/third_party/api/v1/*`. To enable portal settings and write controls (quiet mode, silent schedule, DHW target temperature, Legionella prevention), enter your Weheat Portal email & password (for automatic PKCE token refresh) OR paste a session JSON / Bearer token from `https://portal.weheat.nl/api/auth/session`.

data.portal_session_token: Portal Session JSON or Bearer Token (optional, for SSO accounts)

error.invalid_portal_auth: Failed to authenticate with Weheat Portal. Check your email/password or session token.

set_quiet_mode.name: Set quiet mode
set_quiet_mode.description: Set the performance or quiet mode preset for a Weheat heat pump.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: The quiet mode preset to apply (Performance, Silent 1, Silent 2, Silent 3, Silent 4).

set_silent_schedule.name: Set silent schedule
set_silent_schedule.description: Configure the silent hours preset, active days of week, and daily start/stop quiet window.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Silent hours preset level to activate during the scheduled quiet window.

days.name: Days of the week
days.description: Days of the week to apply the schedule to (leave blank to apply to all 7 days).

start_time.name: Start time
start_time.description: Time when the silent hours period begins (HH:MM).

stop_time.name: Stop time
stop_time.description: Time when the silent hours period ends (HH:MM).

trigger_legionella_prevention.name: Trigger legionella prevention
trigger_legionella_prevention.description: Manually trigger a one-shot Legionella thermal disinfection cycle on the Weheat heat pump.
